```yaml
name: Lazer Sui Contract CI

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Install Sui CLI
      run: |
        curl -L https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/v0.28.0/sui-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | tar xzvf -
        export PATH=$PWD/sui:$PATH

    - name: Test Sui Contract
      run: sui move test --path lazer/contracts/sui/
```
